title: Elite Season Baseball Program in Long Beach & Orange County | MBM
description: Coach Myles's season-long elite program — 30 private 60-minute sessions, priority scheduling, game-film review, and a custom development plan at the best per-session value. Long Beach & OC.
lead: The Elite Season Program is the deepest level of training MBM offers — 30 one-on-one sessions across a full season, built into a single custom development program with priority scheduling, game-film review, and the best per-session value. It's for the player who's all in.
body: A full season of coached development is a different thing than a stack of lessons. With 30 sessions to work with, Coach Myles builds a season-long arc: a clear plan, measurable goals, and the room to develop mechanics, strength, and the mental game in the right order — then revisit and sharpen as the season unfolds.

The program includes priority scheduling so your player's training fits around games and school, video analysis to make progress visible, and game-film review — sitting down with real at-bats and innings to coach decisions and approach, not just mechanics. At roughly $50 a session, it's also the best per-session value MBM offers.

This is a commitment, and Coach Myles treats it like one: tough when it needs to be, encouraging on every good rep, and honest with players and parents about where things stand. It's the right fit for serious players chasing a specific goal — making a team, earning a starting role, or competing at the next level. Apply and Coach Myles will talk through fit before anyone commits.
